# SchemaForge

> An open-source, intelligent, multi-engine schema design and management tool, where a coding agent and an architect work on the same live design through MCP, and nothing lands unchecked: a schema designed from scratch, reverse-engineered from a database, converted from one engine to another, its intelligence stored with it. Every database is an engine plugin; at the centre stands the database SchemaForge keeps its work in: one PostgreSQL database per schema, in the PostgreSQL 18 bundled with the app, holding the cortex every engine shares and each engine's own tables, each owner in its own namespace, designed before any of it is built and locked so every build falls into it.

Start with the brief for coding agents: https://k8nstantin.github.io/schema-forge/agents.xml. The files below are the authority.

## Spec

- [specs/root.xml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/k8nstantin/schema-forge/main/specs/root.xml): identity and purpose, authority (which files decide), method (how every task is built), the sequence of tasks and every decision with its date
- [specs/rules.xml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/k8nstantin/schema-forge/main/specs/rules.xml): every rule, where it comes from, and what catches a breach
- [t01 · spec check: every spec file and owner folder checked, and loaded on PostgreSQL 18](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/k8nstantin/schema-forge/main/specs/tasks/SF-93-spec-check.xml)
- [t05 · mysql live: every MySQL from 5.7 read live, version first and gently, with its usage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/k8nstantin/schema-forge/main/specs/tasks/SF-121-mysql-live.xml)
- [t06 · postgres: PostgreSQL 18 with pgvector, built by our CI for five platforms](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/k8nstantin/schema-forge/main/specs/tasks/t06-postgres.xml)

## Authority

- [schema/cortex/](https://github.com/k8nstantin/schema-forge/tree/main/schema/cortex): every table of the namespace cortex, in the one database schema_forge: the designs, every design people work on a row of cortex.designs, the engine's versions, features, catalog sources and object kinds, the reads of live servers, namespaces, objects, columns and their identities, indexes and their parts, constraints (keys, checks, exclusions and the links between tables, enforced or only drawn) and their columns, dependencies, partitionings and partitions, sort fields, views, routines and their parameters, triggers, sequences, domains, enum values, required extensions, verbatim statements, and the log (branches, turns, operations, row changes, savepoints, locked versions); one CREATE TABLE statement per file, named after its table, every column commented on its line and the same words in its COMMENT ON statements; enforce_rules.sql, the functions that make a rule view a trigger; grant_roles.sql, the roles; rules/, one view per rule, broken_<rule>, the rows breaking it
- [schema/ui/](https://github.com/k8nstantin/schema-forge/tree/main/schema/ui): every table of the namespace ui, which every schema's database holds beside the cortex, whatever its engine: what the tool shows and people keep of it, the subject areas and where each object is placed, custom perspectives and their members, layout pins and pinned notes; kept apart from the cortex for clarity, and treated as the cortex is: versioned by the same log, undone with it, under the same roles and rules; one CREATE TABLE statement per file, every column commented on its line and in its COMMENT ON statements; rules/, one view per rule
- [engines/<engine>/schema/](https://github.com/k8nstantin/schema-forge/tree/main/engines): an engine's own tables, in the namespace engine_<engine> (engine_mysql.table_options), each referring to the cortex row it belongs to; its rules/; created in a schema's database whose engine it is, and in no other
- [docs/owner-template/](https://github.com/k8nstantin/schema-forge/tree/main/docs/owner-template): the shape of every owner's folder (an engine's, a feature's, and the cortex's and the workspace's alike): its owner.toml card, the five shapes of a table, its rules/, seeds/ and migrations/, a rename in two versions
- [postgres/manifest.toml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/k8nstantin/schema-forge/main/postgres/manifest.toml): the PostgreSQL the store bundles: its sources, pinned, and the programs built from them, by checksum
- [crates/model/](https://github.com/k8nstantin/schema-forge/tree/main/crates/model): the model: Schema, Namespace, Object, Column, Link, Area, Id
- [crates/engine/](https://github.com/k8nstantin/schema-forge/tree/main/crates/engine): the engine interface (Engine and its parts), the section layout (crates/engine/src/sections.rs), the registry and the conformance kit
- [engines/mysql/](https://github.com/k8nstantin/schema-forge/tree/main/engines/mysql): the MySQL engine: its versions, types, kinds, options, readers and writer
- [docs/engines.xml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/k8nstantin/schema-forge/main/docs/engines.xml): the plugin design: what is shared and what is each engine's, the crates and their roles
- [docs/connections.xml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/k8nstantin/schema-forge/main/docs/connections.xml): connections: what an engine declares, profiles without secrets, the five test steps
